mapper.select: SELECT book_id, title, author, cover_image_url, created_at FROM books WHERE book_id = #{bookId}

SELECT book_id, title, author, cover_image_url, created_at FROM books WHERE title = #{title} AND ( (author IS NULL AND #{author,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR author = #{author,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) LIMIT 1
SELECT book_id, title, author, cover_image_url, created_at FROM books WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(author, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY book_id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM books WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reading_reports WHERE reading_reports.book_id = books.book_id )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_reports ( student_id, book_id, title, content ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{bookId}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT reading_report_id, student_id, book_id, title, content, submitted_at, updated_at FROM reading_reports WHERE reading_report_id = #{readingReportId}
SELECT reading_report_id, student_id, book_id, title, content, submitted_at, updated_at FROM reading_reports WHERE reading_report_id = #{readingReportId} AND student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT rr.reading_report_id, rr.student_id, rr.book_id, rr.title, rr.content, rr.submitted_at, rr.updated_at FROM reading_reports rr WHERE rr.reading_report_id = #{readingReportId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM class_students cs INNER JOIN class_teachers ct ON ct.class_id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = rr.student_id AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ct.teacher_id = #{teacherId} )
SELECT reading_report_id, student_id, book_id, title, content, submitted_at, updated_at FROM reading_reports WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY reading_report_id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT rr.reading_report_id, rr.student_id, rr.book_id, rr.title, rr.content, rr.submitted_at, rr.updated_at FROM reading_reports rr INNER JOIN class_students cs ON cs.student_id = rr.student_id AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN class_teachers ct ON ct.class_id = cs.class_id WHERE ct.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY rr.reading_report_id ASC
SELECT feedback_id, reading_report_id, teacher_id, content, created_at, updated_at FROM reading_feedbacks WHERE reading_report_id = #{readingReportId}
